introduction_markdown:
**Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board - Ordinary Level Examination. Computer Science (0595), Paper 3 (practical), June 2024. Duration: two and a half hours. Do all the tasks (Task I, Task II and Task III) specified in this question paper.**

Enter the information required in the shaded boxes. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. All written answers should be provided in the spaces provided in this question booklet. Calculators are NOT allowed.

The booklet reproduced here contains three versions of the same practical paper, headed Group One (booklet 0000/0595/3/Grp 1), Group Three (Grp 3) and Group Four (Grp 4); a candidate sits only ONE group. Group One: Task I (word processing, 15 marks), Task II (spreadsheet, 20 marks), Task III (HTML, 15 marks). Group Three: Task 1 (word processing, 20 marks), Task 2 (spreadsheet, 15 marks), Task 3 (HTML, 15 marks). Group Four: Task I (word processing, 20 marks), Task II (spreadsheet, 20 marks), Task III (C or Pascal program, 10 marks). Each group is worth 50 marks.

The working files named in the tasks (pictures, logo, signature) are supplied on the day; they are not reproduced in the printed paper.
enonce_intro_markdown:
**TASK II (20 marks)**

The Mayor of the Tomtom City Council organizes a technology contest to encourage innovation in his municipality. You are required to design a spreadsheet to manage payments to the winners. Every participant that scores 120 points or more on his/her project is a winner and is awarded 100000FCFA. Any Beginner that scores more than 120 points receives an additional 5000FCFA for every score above 120. A tax of 5% of **Total Pay** is deducted.

A sample worksheet for this task is shown in Figure 2. Study the design carefully and answer the questions that follow.

![fig-1](gce-ol-computer-science-2024-p3-officiel-cameroun_exercice_G4-T2_fig_1.png)

*Figure 2: Payment to Best Participants. Row 1: the title "TECH CHALLENGE 2021" (merged A1:K1); J3:J5 hold the labels Tax Rate, Normal score, Extra score rate and K3:K5 the values 5,00%, 120, 5000; row 6: the heading "PAYMENTS TO BEST PARTICIPANTS" (merged A6:K6); row 7: the column headings (A: SN, B: Names, C: Gender, D: Competing Level, E: Score, F: Extra Score, G: Normal Pay, H: Extra Pay, I: Total Pay, J: Tax, K: Net Balance); rows 8 to 17: the ten participants; row 18: TOTAL (merged A18:D18). The columns F, H, I, J, K are empty.*

Launch a spreadsheet application installed in your computer and carry out the following in a single Workbook:

Les questions 3 et 4 (enregistrer, imprimer) n'ont pas de points imprimés. Le titre imprimé dans la figure est « TECH CHALLENGE 2021 » alors que la session est 2024 : recopié tel quel.

Figure 2 (page 12) : extraite sans filigrane (régime « cuit », filtre de niveaux ; contrôle OCR OK ; fantômes légers du verso dans la zone des colonnes Extra Pay à Net Balance, sans effet sur la lecture). Valeurs relues sur l'image : scores 150, 123, 141, 120, 120, 120, 120, 144, 137, 150 ; niveaux Beginner / Intermediate ; Normal Pay 100000 ; paramètres K3 = 5,00 %, K4 = 120, K5 = 5000. Les numéros de ligne de la figure sont tronqués à gauche : lignes 7 (en-têtes) à 18 (TOTAL) déduites des plages de la question 1 (A7:K18, A18:D18).

Question 2.6 : le sujet écrit « The column total of Column E, in cell E18. Write the spreadsheet formula in the cell K18 » (E18 puis K18). Transcrit tel quel ; le corrigé donne =SUM(E8:E17) pour E18 et =SUM(K8:K17) pour K18 (copie de la formule vers la droite).

Règle du texte et formules imprimées : le texte réserve le supplément aux « Beginner », mais les formules 2.1 et 2.2 imprimées ([Score - Normal score], [Extra Score * Extra score rate]) ne testent pas le niveau, donc les Intermediate CHO BRANDON (141) et RITA ZEN (137) reçoivent un supplément. Le corrigé donne les formules imprimées et signale la variante avec IF et ses totaux (calculés avec Python). Tous les résultats (extra score, paie, impôt, solde, totaux 1 325 ; 125 ; 1 000 000 ; 625 000 ; 1 625 000 ; 81 250 ; 1 543 750) ont été recalculés avec Python ; aucun tableur n'a été exécuté.

questions.enonce_markdown:
2. Input appropriate formulae to calculate:

2.1 The **Extra Score**. [*Score - Normal score*] for the first participant. Use correct cell references to ensure that you get the correct results when you copy the formula to corresponding cells of other participants. Write the spreadsheet formula in the space below. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The first participant (ASTA MANDI) is in row 8: the score is in **E8** and the Normal score (120) is in **K4**. The cell K4 must not move when the formula is copied down, so it is made **absolute** with dollar signs:

**F8: `=E8-$K$4`**

(150 - 120 = 30 for ASTA MANDI.) Copied to F9:F17, the reference to the score changes (E9, E10, ...) and the reference `$K$4` stays fixed. Without the dollar signs, F9 would use K5 (5000), which is wrong.

Remark: this formula follows the question (Score - Normal score). The text of the task says that only a **Beginner** receives an additional pay; to apply that rule strictly one would write `=IF(D8="Beginner",E8-$K$4,0)` (see the note after question 2.7).

Marking idea (2 marks): Score minus Normal score (1); K4 made absolute `$K$4` (1).

questions.enonce_markdown:
2. Input appropriate formulae to calculate:

2.2 The **Extra Pay**. [*Extra Score * Extra score rate*] for the first participant. Use correct cell references to ensure that you get the correct results when you copy the formula to corresponding cells of other participants. Write the spreadsheet formula in the space below. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The Extra Pay is the Extra Score (column F) multiplied by the Extra score rate (5000, in **K5**, fixed):

**H8: `=F8*$K$5`**

(30 x 5000 = 150,000 for ASTA MANDI.)

Marking idea (2 marks): F8 multiplied by the rate (1); K5 made absolute `$K$5` (1).

questions.enonce_markdown:
2. Input appropriate formulae to calculate:

2.3 The **Total Pay**. [*Normal Pay + Extra Pay*] for the first participant. Use correct cell references to ensure that you get the correct results when you copy the formula to corresponding cells of other participants. Write the spreadsheet formula in the space below. *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The Total Pay adds the Normal Pay (column G) and the Extra Pay (column H):

**I8: `=G8+H8`**

(100,000 + 150,000 = 250,000 for ASTA MANDI.) Both references are relative: they follow the row when the formula is copied.

questions.enonce_markdown:
2. Input appropriate formulae to calculate:

2.4 The **Tax**. [*Tax rate*Total pay*] for the first participant. Use correct cell references to ensure that you get the correct results when you copy the formula to corresponding cells of other participants. Write the spreadsheet formula in the space below. *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The Tax is the Tax rate (5%, in **K3**, fixed) multiplied by the Total Pay (column I):

**J8: `=$K$3*I8`**

(5% x 250,000 = 12,500 for ASTA MANDI.)

questions.enonce_markdown:
2. Input appropriate formulae to calculate:

2.5 The **Net Balance**. [*Total Pay - Tax*] for the first participant. Use correct cell references to ensure that you get the correct results when you copy the formula to corresponding cells of other participants. Write the spreadsheet formula in the space below. *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The Net Balance is the Total Pay minus the Tax:

**K8: `=I8-J8`**

(250,000 - 12,500 = 237,500 for ASTA MANDI.)

questions.enonce_markdown:
2. Input appropriate formulae to calculate:

2.6 The column total of Column E, in cell E18. Write the spreadsheet formula in the cell K18 in the space below. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The total of a column is obtained with the **SUM** function over the ten participants (rows 8 to 17):

**E18: `=SUM(E8:E17)`**  (the total of the Scores: 1,325)

The statement names the cell E18 (the first cell after the merged label TOTAL) and then the cell K18; the same formula is copied to the other columns (question 2.7), so the formula found in **K18** is **`=SUM(K8:K17)`**, which gives 1,543,750.

Marking idea (2 marks): SUM function (1); correct range E8:E17 (or K8:K17) (1).

questions.enonce_markdown: Copy all the formulae you entered above into corresponding adjacent cells *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
